verdict.rationale: Reporting on dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift and review workload, with board-ready exports, is a fair ask of a fraud and chargeback platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only decision APIs, notifications, chargeback ingestion, integrations and SSO. Nothing documents a metrics dashboard, KPI reporting or data export; the 'analytics team' mention refers to model calibration during onboarding, not merchant reporting.
